description: Source code for the AKM09918C sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, sample fetching, attribute handling, and device registration.

methods.name: akm09918c_sample_fetch_helper
methods.description: Fetches sensor samples over I2C, handling power modes and data readiness.

methods.name: akm09918c_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data samples and updates internal state.

methods.name: akm09918c_convert
methods.description: Converts raw sensor sample to sensor_value in microgauss.

methods.name: akm09918c_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves sensor data for specified channel(s).

methods.name: akm09918c_attr_get
methods.description: Gets sensor attribute, such as sampling frequency.

methods.name: akm09918c_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attribute, such as sampling frequency.

methods.name: akm09918c_check_who_am_i
methods.description: Verifies device identity via WHO_AM_I register.

methods.name: akm09918c_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, performs reset and ID check.
